footerFamilySweep.question: Does any archived Codex startup prefix paint the context/shortcut footer (context left) beside an empty composer, i.e. a positive frame of that footer family?
footerFamilySweep.method: For every C:\logs\antiphon\session-runner\*.ansi.log: head -c 24000; count files whose prefix contains 'OpenAI Codex'; of those, count files whose prefix contains 'context left'; for each hit, ANSI-strip the prefix and inspect the rows around the first 'context left' plus marker counts for '[antiphon-task', 'Working', 'tab to queue' and 'model: … loading'. Read-only; no replay through TerminalScreen; no live launch.
footerFamilySweep.finding: In all 18 hits the 'context left' row is the occupied-composer / queue-mode footer painted while 'Starting MCP servers' or 'Booting MCP server' is on screen, with 'tab to queue message' present and the composer holding typed text ('› [antiphon-task:…', '› 007', '› Run /review…'). No archive shows it beside an empty composer or an idle hint. The three positive captures and incident attempt 1's empty composer all paint the '<model> <effort> · <cwd>' footer.
footerFamilySweep.contractConsequence: Plan D-8: contract item 3 supports only the model/effort/cwd footer family. 'context left' in the bottom region is unknown alone and the queue-mode blocker with 'tab to queue message'. No P-4 positive capture exists; widening requires a complete sanitized capture added here first.
footerFamilySweep.limits: Prefix-bounded (24 KB) and substring-based; it establishes absence of an empty-composer instance in the archive's startup prefixes, not the CLI's full footer grammar. Hits are archive IDs, not rendered fixtures; none is a positive frame.
